title: Give results different names
summary: GraphQL: Give results different names. Add an alias called larger for input 5.
introduction: Aliases name two uses of the same field so both results can appear together.
learningObjectives: Give results different names with GraphQL
Add an alias called larger for input 5

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.

blocks.title: Give results different names

blocks.text: small and big are response aliases. Their different inputs produce 4 and 8.
Add an alias called larger for input 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Two different arguments on one field need distinct response names.
